verdict.rationale: The evidence documents `pulumi preview` showing proposed changes ([pulumi-docs-8], [pulumi-docs-19]), but never says that output is available as JSON or another machine-readable format an agent can parse. Several nearby items do not deliver the story. Automation API is described only generically as a programmatic interface, with no statement about structured preview results. Exit codes are an adjacent signal, not a plan representation. `--import-file` is an import-generation feature, not a parseable change plan.
